info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Insurance Claims Claims Payouts-v1-spec
info.description: The Insurance Claims Payout API allows users to access detailed information regarding the payouts associated with insurance claims. This endpoint is designed for insurers, claims adjusters, and auditors who need to retrieve payout data for analysis and reporting. By using this API, stakeholders can effectively evaluate claim situations and manage their insurance portfolios. It supports efficient tracking of financial settlements related to claims, ensuring transparency and aiding in decision-making processes.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to retrieve detailed information about claims payouts, including relevant data such as claim identifiers, payout status, and other associated metadata.

requestBody.description: Submit a request to retrieve the payout details of claims. This request may include various parameters defining the scope and criteria for the payout information being requested.

ListInsuranceClaimsClaimsPayoutsRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation related to claims payout. It is expected to contain a string value.
